description: This Java source file contains unit tests for the DefaultClientActorPropsFactory class within the Eclipse Ditto project, specifically testing the serialization and deserialization of actor properties for different messaging connection types such as AMQP, MQTT, and Kafka. The tests ensure that actor props are serializable across different connectivity instances, which is critical for distributed actor system scenarios.
